summary: CR-030 v2 — tested POST /api/pos/webhook after the Body-wrapper removal fix. All 12 tests pass (100%). The endpoint now accepts raw Freshmarketer format directly (no FreshmarketerBody wrapper). The exact user-reported payload returns 200 (was 422 before fix). TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND for the user's template is confirmed as correct behavior. Idempotency, event-filtering, mobile/template_id validation, and regression endpoints all verified.

minor.issue: Idempotency (status:replayed) only works on unsupported/ignored events that get logged. For list.add_contact events that fail TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND, no webhook_log entry is written — so a duplicate call with same id will process again (not replayed). This is a design gap, not a regression of this fix.

action_items: Optional: Consider logging failed webhook attempts (TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND, MOBILE_REQUIRED etc.) to webhook_logs so idempotency also protects against duplicate failed calls.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct — FreshmarketerWebhookPayload is now the top-level model, no Body wrapper. Endpoint reads payload directly.
The 422 bug is fully resolved: all raw Freshmarketer formats (integer event_time, integer list_id/contact_id, integer mobile in custom_data) are accepted.
TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND for template 64da2a07-7a73-49a9-8e0c-7b7545623215 is expected and correct — template doesn't exist for pos_0001_restaurant_689 user.
seed_data_creation: Idempotency test creates a webhook_log entry with event=contact.updated (ignored) for each test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CR-030 v2: POST /api/pos/webhook fully tested with raw Freshmarketer format (no Body wrapper). All 12 tests pass. The exact user payload now returns 200 (TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND is expected). GET /api/pos/templates and POST /api/pos/send regressions pass.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: The previous implementation had a FreshmarketerBody wrapper class that expected {Headers, Body} nested format. Freshmarketer actually sends event fields directly as the HTTP body. Fix: Removed FreshmarketerBody, made FreshmarketerWebhookPayload the top-level model. Endpoint now reads `payload` directly instead of `payload.Body`. Result: 422 Unprocessable Entity (field_required: body.Body) is fully resolved.
